svg.text: dr_view: unit by unit, in the preset's order
nothing from the host between the stages
The layers' raster passes (COUNT to FILL) and SHADE, then LIGHT with its glass form, SHOW and the PUSH;
the parts' medians, ms, from measurements/lit_frame. m: masked, g: glass.
